## Feature Summary
A concise description of the proposed feature or improvement.

## Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or limitation? Please describe. (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when...")

## Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like. Be specific about APIs or user experience.

## Package vs. Web App Scope
- [ ] Belongs in framework-agnostic `resumescore-core` (deterministic heuristic, taxonomy, AST)
- [ ] Belongs in Next.js web application (`src/app/`, UI, export, local storage)
- [ ] Both

## Alternatives Considered
A clear description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Additional Context / Prior Art
Links, research, or standard resume guidelines that support this request.
